column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.
